events_list.rationale: Pass-through (read): cluster event stream the kubeconfig already reaches.

nodes_log.rationale: Pass-through (read): node log output. May contain incidental secrets, but reading is not disclosure of a reusable credential.

nodes_top.rationale: Pass-through (metadata-only): node CPU and memory usage.

pods_delete.rationale: Deletes a pod. Usually recreated by its controller, so recoverable, but disruptive and can lose local state.

pods_exec.rationale: Arbitrary command execution inside a running container, with whatever access that pod's service account holds.

pods_list_in_namespace.rationale: Pass-through (read): pod inventory scoped to one namespace.

pods_log.rationale: Pass-through (read): container log output the kubeconfig already reaches; yields no reusable credential.

pods_run.rationale: Runs an arbitrary container image in the cluster — arbitrary code execution by another name.

pods_top.rationale: Pass-through (metadata-only): pod CPU and memory usage.

resources_create_or_update.rationale: Server-side apply of any manifest. Can create privileged workloads, RBAC bindings, or admission configuration.

resources_delete.rationale: Deletes any resource by kind, including namespaces and PersistentVolumeClaims. Not recoverable through this tool.

resources_get.rationale: Credential disclosure. `kind` is a free-form string, so `kind: Secret` returns cluster credentials — database passwords, cloud keys, TLS private keys. Governed for the worst case; narrow with a policy condition on /arguments/kind.

resources_list.rationale: Credential disclosure, and broader than resources_get: `kind: Secret` enumerates every Secret in a namespace in one call.

resources_scale.rationale: Changes replica count. Scaling to zero is an outage and scaling up is a cost event; reversible either way.
